title: Acquisition of minority stake in Vaidya Logistics
text:
The client holds an existing eighteen percent interest and proposes to acquire a further nineteen percent from two of the founding promoters, taking it just below the threshold that would trigger an open offer.

Commercial terms were agreed in principle at a meeting in Pune on the fourteenth. The valuation is anchored to audited figures for the year ending March, with a completion adjustment for net debt and working capital.

Our immediate priority is the disclosure schedule. The vendors have not yet produced the litigation annexure, and two of the warranties on title cannot be given without it.

sections.heading: Scope of engagement
sections.text: Counsel will advise on the share purchase agreement, the shareholders agreement and the ancillary transaction documents. Regulatory clearances before the Competition Commission are excluded and will be handled by separate counsel.

sections.heading: Fee arrangement
sections.text: Work is billed at the partner and associate rates set out in the engagement letter, reviewed each April. A capped estimate applies to the drafting phase; anything beyond the cap requires written approval before it is incurred.

sections.heading: Conflicts
sections.text: A conflicts check was run against the acquirer, the target and both sets of promoters. One historic instruction for a director in an unrelated personal matter was identified and waived in writing by both parties.

title: Reviewing vendor disclosure against warranty schedule
text:
Read the third draft of the disclosure letter received overnight from the vendors' advisers, cross-referring each item against the corresponding warranty.

Identified four disclosures that are too general to qualify the warranty they purport to address and drafted a note setting out why each fails the fair disclosure standard agreed in the heads of terms.

Call with the client to explain the exposure that remains if the schedule is accepted as drafted, and to take instructions on which four points to press.

title: Invoice INV-2026-0417
text:
This account covers work carried out between the first and the thirtieth of the month on the corporate acquisition instructed in February.

The capped estimate for the drafting phase has not been exceeded. Approximately eleven hours of the total relate to the disclosure review, which was authorised separately by email on the nineteenth.

A credit has been applied for the duplicated conference call recorded twice by two fee earners. It was identified on internal review before the account was rendered.

sections.heading: Professional services rendered
sections.text: Preparation and negotiation of transaction documents, attendance at three client meetings, correspondence with opposing counsel, and review of the vendor disclosure schedule across the period.

sections.heading: Disbursements
sections.text: Registry search fees, notarisation of two powers of attorney, and travel to Pune for the commercial meeting. Receipts are attached and are recoverable at cost without uplift.

sections.heading: Payment terms
sections.text: Settlement is due thirty days from the date shown. Amounts outstanding beyond that carry interest at the rate stated in the engagement letter. Queries should be raised within fourteen days.

title: Records retention and destruction policy
text:
This policy applies to every record created or received in the course of professional work, in any format, including material held on personal devices under the remote working arrangement.

Responsibility sits with the supervising partner for each matter rather than with a central function. Central administration operates the schedule; it does not decide what falls within it.

Nothing here overrides a statutory retention period or an undertaking given to a third party. Where the two conflict, the longer period governs and the reason is recorded.

sections.heading: Why we keep what we keep
sections.text: Holding material longer than necessary increases what is exposed in a breach and what must be produced on discovery. Holding it for too short a period risks being unable to answer a claim years later. The schedule below is the compromise and is reviewed annually.

sections.heading: Client files
sections.text: A closed file is held for seven years from the date of the final account, then destroyed unless a hold has been placed on it. Original documents belonging to the client are returned or destroyed on instruction, never retained by default.

sections.heading: Legal holds
sections.text: Where litigation is anticipated, ordinary destruction stops immediately for anything that might be relevant. The hold is recorded against the matter, and lifting one requires the same authority that imposed it.

sections.heading: Destruction method
sections.text: Paper is cross-cut shredded on site. Electronic material is deleted from primary storage and from backups at the next rotation, and a certificate is produced for each batch.

title: Summary of commercial lease, Unit 4 Kharadi
text:
The lease was executed in 2019 and registered. This summary reflects the counterpart supplied by the landlord's agent and one deed of variation dated the following year.

Two provisions depart from the market norm and are flagged in the sections below. The outright prohibition on subletting part is the more commercially significant of the two.

A rent review fell due last year and appears never to have been triggered. Whether the landlord can still operate it depends on whether time was of the essence, which the drafting leaves open.

sections.heading: Term and renewal
sections.text: Nine years from the commencement date, with a tenant option to renew for a further five exercisable no earlier than twelve months and no later than six months before expiry. The option is lost if rent is in arrears on the date it is exercised.

sections.heading: Rent review
sections.text: Upward only, every third year, to open market rent for comparable space in the locality. Failing agreement the matter goes to an independent surveyor acting as expert rather than arbitrator, whose determination binds both parties.

sections.heading: Repair obligations
sections.text: The tenant keeps the interior in good and substantial repair. Structure, roof and common areas remain with the landlord, recovered through the service charge, which is capped at a fixed percentage increase year on year.

sections.heading: Alienation
sections.text: Assignment of the whole is permitted with landlord consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Subletting part is prohibited outright, which materially limits what the client can do with the mezzanine.

title: किरायेदारी विवाद — दुकान संख्या बारह, सदाशिव पेठ
text:
यह मामला लघु वाद न्यायालय में लंबित है और वर्तमान में साक्ष्य के चरण में है।

बकाया राशि का दावा विवादित है। हमारे पक्षकार का कहना है कि भुगतान नकद में किया गया था और रसीदें जारी नहीं की गईं, जो इस क्षेत्र में असामान्य नहीं है।

समझौते की संभावना बनी हुई है। मकान मालिक ने अनौपचारिक रूप से एकमुश्त राशि के बदले कब्जा छोड़ने का प्रस्ताव रखा है, जिस पर निर्देश लिए जाने हैं।

sections.heading: तथ्य
sections.text: पक्षकार पिछले सत्रह वर्षों से परिसर में व्यापार कर रहे हैं। मकान मालिक ने बकाया राशि और स्वयं के उपयोग की आवश्यकता, दोनों आधारों पर बेदखली की कार्यवाही आरंभ की है।

sections.heading: कानूनी स्थिति
sections.text: स्वयं के उपयोग का आधार तभी टिकता है जब आवश्यकता वास्तविक हो और तुलनात्मक कठिनाई का परीक्षण पूरा हो। इस मामले में मकान मालिक के पास उसी गली में दो अन्य रिक्त परिसर उपलब्ध हैं।

sections.heading: अगला कदम
sections.text: किराया रसीदों की प्रमाणित प्रतियाँ मँगवाई जाएँ और बिजली बिलों के माध्यम से निरंतर कब्जे को स्थापित किया जाए। सुनवाई की अगली तिथि से पहले लिखित बयान दाखिल करना आवश्यक है।

title: Client onboarding standard operating procedure
text:
This procedure applies before any substantive work begins, including advice given informally at a first meeting.

The order matters. Identity is established first because everything after it depends on knowing who is being dealt with, and a risk rating applied to an unverified party is a number without a subject.

Deviations require written approval from the compliance partner before the fact, not an explanation afterwards. There is no retrospective sign off in this process.

sections.heading: Identity verification
sections.text: For an individual, a government photograph identifier and a proof of address dated within three months. For a company, the certificate of incorporation, the register of members, and identification for anyone holding more than twenty five percent.

sections.heading: Source of funds
sections.text: Ask where the money is coming from and record the answer in the client's own words. An answer that cannot be explained plainly is itself the finding, and the file should not proceed on an assumption about what was meant.

sections.heading: Risk rating
sections.text: Every new relationship is rated at the point of opening and again whenever the instruction changes materially. A higher rating does not mean refusing the work; it means shorter review intervals and a named partner accountable for them.

sections.heading: When to stop
sections.text: If verification cannot be completed, the file does not open and no work is done, including preparatory work. Declining is recorded with the reason, because a pattern of declines carries information that a single decline does not.

title: Invoice INV-2026-0388
text:
Rendered in respect of the compliance review instructed in January and completed this month.

The written opinion took longer than estimated because the limitation position differs across the three states in which the client operates, and each had to be addressed separately.

No disbursements arise on this account.

sections.heading: Advisory work
sections.text: Drafting of the records retention schedule, two workshops with the administration team, and a written opinion on the interaction between the schedule and the statutory limitation periods.

sections.heading: Adjustments
sections.text: The workshop originally scheduled for the twelfth was cancelled by the client at short notice. Half the allocated time is charged in accordance with the engagement letter and is shown separately below.

title: Employment termination and restrictive covenant advice
text:
The individual has been in post for four years and reports to the commercial director. Performance is not in issue; the appointment is being ended for reorganisation reasons.

There is a contractual notice period of three months and a payment in lieu clause. Exercising the clause preserves the covenants; allowing the employment simply to lapse without following the contract puts them at risk.

A settlement agreement is recommended in preference to a bare termination, principally because it converts an uncertain covenant position into agreed and acknowledged obligations.

sections.heading: Instruction
sections.text: Advise on terminating a senior sales appointment and on what can realistically be enforced afterwards against a departing employee who is expected to join a direct competitor.

sections.heading: Enforceability
sections.text: The twelve month non-compete is almost certainly too wide as drafted. It covers the whole country and every line of business, where the individual worked one region and one product. A court asked to enforce it is likelier to strike it down entirely than to read it narrowly.

sections.heading: What is worth pursuing
sections.text: The confidentiality obligation and the customer non-solicit stand on much better ground. Both are tied to people this individual actually dealt with, and both are limited to six months, which is defensible for the role.

sections.heading: Practical advice
sections.text: Secure the customer relationships now. A visible handover completed before the departure is worth more than a covenant argued about for a year, and it costs nothing but planning.

title: Minutes of the board meeting held on the ninth
text:
The meeting opened at eleven and closed at ten past one.

One director declared an interest in the third item and withdrew for the duration of that discussion. The declaration is recorded in the register kept for that purpose.

The next meeting is fixed for the second week of the following quarter, with papers to circulate seven days in advance.

sections.heading: Present and quorum
sections.text: Four directors attended in person and one by video. The company secretary confirmed that a quorum was present and that notice had been given in accordance with the articles.

sections.heading: Approval of the annual accounts
sections.text: The accounts for the year ended March were tabled together with the auditors report. After discussion of the treatment of the development expenditure, they were approved and the chair was authorised to sign on behalf of the board.

sections.heading: Banking authorities
sections.text: Existing mandates were reviewed. The threshold for single signature payments was reduced, and two directors who have left the business were removed as authorised signatories with immediate effect.

sections.heading: Any other business
sections.text: The proposed acquisition of a minority stake was noted as progressing. No decision was sought at this meeting and the matter stands adjourned to the next.
